profile_text.body:
AI Now Institute is a nonprofit organization founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York, NY, with its website at ainowinstitute.org. It describes itself as challenging and reimagining the current trajectory for AI.

The material on its site is research and commentary rather than products. Its senior research scientist, Boyan Milanov, argues that AI doomerism is not based on scientific work and that calls for regulation from inside the industry are in reality attempts by AI companies to set their own standards. Aya Ibrahim, commenting after NVIDIA announced a new agent safety platform, warned against one-size-fits-all security steps. Heidy Khlaaf, its chief AI scientist, said that acknowledging the harms of AI technology would not be profitable for AI companies, and wrote in an op-ed that high-risk industries from aviation to banking are subject to independent oversight and meaningful penalties, and that AI companies should be no exception.

The institute's profile lists no products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. It records New York as its law exposure jurisdiction, with a count of 459.
